evidence.finalAssistantMessage: Runner response was classified as malformed because Tested state and Commands tuples lacked required delimiters; candidate publication was not observed.
evidence.priorProgress: slice-01 EXECUTE_SLICE and VALIDATE_SLICE both passed in the same fresh replay

rootCause: The runner output gate required complete paths and digests but did not spell out the exact pipe-delimited tuple grammar consumed by the execution-record parser. The producer returned tuple-like prose without the required `| sha256:<64hex>` and `| exit:<integer>` delimiters.
authorityDecision: Preserve strict parser tuple grammar and malformed-output classification. Add the exact serialized forms to the producer instructions; do not add aliases or repair delimiters in the caller.
